title: Claude Code: Orchestrate teams of Claude Code sessions
summary: Experimental (CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1): a lead session spawns teammates, each its own Claude Code instance, with a shared task list and mailboxes. Teammates show in an agent panel below the prompt, or in tmux or iTerm2 split panes. Limits: one team per session, no nesting, in-process teammates are not restored on resume, the lead is fixed, permissions are set at spawn.
ideas: A shared task list with blocked tasks mirrors an intent's tasks.
Not durable enough for intents that live for days: teammates end with the lead's process.

took.idea: Not adopted: teams end with the session
